1.consolidated_definition: Plato hecho con maíz tierno rallado, hervido con leche de vaca o coco, sal y azúcar. Un poco caldoso. También llamado mundonuevo y mazamorra.
1.en_consolidated_definition: A dish made with young corn grated and cooked in cow's milk or coconut milk, salt, and sugar. Slightly soupy. Also known as mundonuevo and mazamorra.
